retrievalProfile.description: A centered, full-body studio portrait featuring a symmetrical power pose against a neutral gradient background with stylized condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body, centered female subject in a wide-legged stance, wearing black high-waisted attire and gold jewelry, set against a seamless grey studio backdrop with a soft floor-to-wall transition. The composition is anchored by a large, stylized display name on the left and a smaller subtitle at the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical subject stance balancing the asymmetrical text placement
High-contrast black clothing against a mid-tone grey background
Gold jewelry providing warm metallic highlights to a cool-toned palette
Verticality of the subject mirrored by the condensed letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered full-body figure occupying the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands at the top center, framed by the arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face down the vertical line of the body to the feet, then outward to the display text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space to the left and right of the torso, utilized for typographic placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral mid-grey background providing a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the clothing and hair, creating a sharp silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold for jewelry and red for lips.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Custom swash extensions on specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'J' features a deep, rounded descender loop
Final 'J' features a mirrored deep, rounded descender loop

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space beside the torso

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed stylized display type and wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary ultra-condensed skeleton for modification.
Alternative for a heavy condensed feel, though requires thinning.
Suitable for the wide-tracked subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a woman in a symmetrical wide-legged stance, wearing a black bra top and high-waisted black briefs with gold jewelry, against a seamless grey studio backdrop with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in ultra-condensed white sans-serif to the left of the torso with custom loops on the 'J's. Add the title in wide-tracked bold white sans-serif at the bottom center between the feet.

verificationChecks: Are the 'J' swashes symmetrical in their curve?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the gap between the feet?
Is the background a smooth grey gradient?

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical symmetry in the pose
Ensure text does not overlap the subject's body
Verify the metallic sheen on the gold accents
Confirm the ultra-condensed nature of the display font
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Studio Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Display Type + Neutral Gradient Backdrop
